$comment: Library colours for Camelot keys and BPM, and the rule for which tracks mix well together. Apps copy these values; the Android unit tests check its copy matches. Colours are tuned for the dark UI (all at least 8:1 on #0B0C0F).

compatibility.keys: Same key, one step either way on the Camelot wheel (same letter, wrapping 12 to 1), or the relative major/minor (same number, other letter).
compatibility.tempo: Compatible when the incoming BPM, or its half or double, is within maxTempoAdjust of the outgoing BPM.

bpmColours.rule: bin = round(24 * log2(bpm / 120)) mod 24. Tempos an octave apart share a colour, matching half/double-time mixing; neighbouring bins are neighbouring hues.
